objective:
A Python library for fixed-point decimal money arithmetic that never loses
cents.

It should provide: a money type storing an integer number of minor units and a
three-letter currency code; addition, subtraction and comparison that refuse to
mix currencies; multiplication by a rational rate with banker's rounding to the
nearest minor unit; allocation of an amount across a list of integer ratios so
that the parts sum exactly to the original with remainders distributed one
minor unit at a time; parsing and formatting for currencies with two and with
zero decimal places; and exact behaviour on negative amounts and on halfway
cases.

Pure standard library. Correctness at the boundaries is the whole point of this
library, so the tests should cover halfway rounding and exact allocation sums.
